hero.title: Undergraduate Engineering in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: A **Bachelor’s in Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** can be a pathway for students interested in designing, building and improving systems, machines, infrastructure and technology. Engineering programmes in Mauritius include chemical, civil, mechanical, electrical and electronic, mechatronics, telecommunications and industrial engineering. Students planning to **study Engineering in Mauritius** can explore different specialisations based on their academic interests and career goals.

overview: The University of Mauritius lists several four-year Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) programmes for the 2026–2027 academic year. The Université des Mascareignes also offers engineering programmes, including a four-year BEng pathway. These **Engineering Universities in Mauritius** provide options for students considering undergraduate engineering education abroad.

faq.question: Can Indian students study a Bachelor’s in Engineering in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Yes, Indian students can explore eligible programmes, subject to academic requirements, international admission rules and intake availability. Confirm that your Class 12 subjects meet the requirements for your chosen engineering specialisation. Bachelor’s in Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students offers an overseas education option for eligible applicants.

faq.question: How many years does a Bachelor’s in Engineering take in Mauritius?
faq.answer: The BEng (Hons) programmes listed by the University of Mauritius generally have a four-year full-time duration. Université des Mascareignes also lists four-year BEng pathways.

faq.question: What is the cost of studying engineering in Mauritius in MUR and INR?
faq.answer: For one published example, Université des Mascareignes lists MUR 84,000 per year for non-SADC international students on its BEng course page. This is approximately ₹1.69 lakh per year or ₹6.75 lakh over four years at the illustrative exchange rate used here. Confirm the applicable intake fee and any additional charges.

faq.question: Which engineering specialisations can I study in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Options listed by the University of Mauritius include Civil, Mechanical, Chemical, Mechatronics, Electrical and Electronic, and Telecommunications Engineering. Other institutions offer additional engineering-related pathways.

faq.question: Is an engineering degree from Mauritius recognised in India?
faq.answer: Recognition depends on the institution, awarding body, programme and requirements applicable to the intended employment or further study. Before enrolling, verify the exact qualification with the relevant Indian authorities, employer or university. Do not assume that a degree automatically provides professional recognition in every country.
